title: Dickie Wells replaces him at the Shady Rest
summary: At the Shady Rest in Newark Dickie Wells came up with Durham's book and took his trombone chair; Durham stayed one year with Basie.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Well, now, this is when -- let's see, Dickie Rouse says that you and Basie got together on a whole lot of things now, though, for the band, because the band was the band's personnel was changing a bit, wasn't it?
Yeah, well, I gave it a story -- we didn't get on anything -- well, Digger Wells went in my place.

Yeah. They were playing the Shady Rest in Newark, big place, packed. They opened at 9:00, I got there about 9:30. When I got there I had put my uniform on, Dickie Wells come up with my book under his arm, and his on. I said, here's your new trombone player.
How long were you with Basie then?
